scope: Own portable profile archive storage foundation; application IPC/CLI/GUI not yet connected

contract.format: LCPROF01 + u32 little-endian manifest length +32 raw SHA256 bytes +strict JSON manifest +typed binary payloads, each with length and SHA256
contract.contents: One NamedProfile: Screen, ScreenMedia, Fan or Pump. Exact full active/cached image/font/video dependency set, including builtin image/video bytes; deduplicated by kind/key.
contract.import: Validate all metadata, checksums and typed payloads in numbered private staging before publishing assets. New keys, typed remap only, preserve exact sensor IDs/text and image/media names. No HID or active settings application.
contract.atomicity: No-clobber atomic export_file; import ProfileStore expected_revision CAS replaces only target slot. Concurrent edits are retained. Post-validation publication failure/CAS conflict may leave valid unreferenced imported assets for ordinary cleanup; incomplete profile never published.
contract.bounds: Manifest1MiB,1024 dependencies,payload8GiB,image/font16MiB each,normalized images960x960,font aggregate64MiB,existing media256MiB/86400frames/8MiB index; copy64KiB with one image/font/AU in memory

coverage: empty-store roundtrip: Basic/cached Rain,shared images/fonts/video,independent sensor label/unit fonts,typed key remap leaves colliding sensor/text strings intact
image/video names and raw font bytes preserved; library restart and neighboring group retained
truncation,manifest/payload corruption,missing/duplicate/extra dependencies,bad key/version/length/trailing data reject before asset publication
valid checksums with invalid image/font/media data also reject before asset publication
ScreenMedia,Fan,Pump slots; no-overwrite export_file; missing source and writer failure
stale revision rejects before read; invalid target rejects before payload; concurrent edit during read wins final CAS
indexed video600frames/>1MiB transfers with read/write calls<=64KiB and preserves final access unit

checks.ui_native: NOT RUN: no archive application endpoints or frontend changed in this slice
checks.hardware: NOT RUN: user deferred; no production daemon or HID commands

remaining: Bounded IPC export/upload sessions, admission/global disk quota/expiry/cancel/status and idempotent Finish after lost response
CLI and GUI import/export workflows with progress, explicit target slot and errors/readback
Unix IPC/browser/isolated-native roundtrip and transport/fault/cleanup qualification
Applicable Windows archive workflow/format interoperability; this own named-slot container is not a full device backup
